{{Top|leg|canon=Composite-beam pinpoint laser turret}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Superlaser2.jpg|thumb|The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] firing its [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]]]
The '''composite-beam laser''' focused multiple laser beams, which meet at a central point, into a single, considerably more powerful beam, which is sent along a different angle. Unsurprisingly, such a device could be exceptionally destructive. Examples include the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] and the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]]. Smaller examples include [[Arb Skynxnex]]'s [[double blaster]] and the anti-infantry turrets on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT/i]]. The [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid]] uses a homing variant of the composite beam laser.

In some battles, beam cannon turrets were constructed by [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] in strategic places to prevent enemies from passing by. An example of this was during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. There were two turrets set up on elevated platforms near the main Republic command post to slow the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] army from advancing into the area. Also, the [[crab cannon]] used during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]] by the Separatists had a beam-laser as its main weapon.
